findings.disposition_reason: lens-correctness round 2: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:372-374 names the hand-made local-mainline commit, says it rides the hook with an empty candidate like a landed push, and names remote branch protection as the only check that sees it; matches default_base in scripts/aegis/aegis_cli/core.py:596-620, which prefers the local mainline when it is ahead of the remote
findings.message: The trust-model sentence says a push of the mainline is transport of what `land` already judged, but the base now trusts anything on the local mainline: a commit made there by hand with no task passes the pre-push hook with an empty candidate (it was refused as 'belongs to no task' before), and CI on a push of main is empty too, so that case is now unseen by the framework end to end.
findings.minimal_fix: Add one clause: a commit made on the local mainline outside `land` rides through the hook the same way; only branch protection on the remote sees it.
